 Joe Keery is dishing on keeping up with his Stranger Things co-stars! 
 While the cast has moved on to work on other projects since the series ended nearly a year ago, the 34-year-old actor, who played Steve Harrington, is revealing that they still have an active group chat.
 1 
 Joe Keery reveals who uses the group chat the most
 While speaking with People at the opening night of his Broadway play, Other Desert Cities , last week, Joe revealed that the Stranger Things cast still use their group chat. 
 He also shared that one co-star in particular is the most active in the text chain. 
 “Oh, man, maybe Finn [Wolfhard ] , I guess maybe, yeah, we’re keeping in touch,” he said. 
 Joe Keery reveals Broadway advice from Sadie Sink
 Before Joe made his Broadway debut, his ST co-star Sadie Sink is a Broadway vet, having appearing in three shows, including Annie and the most recent, John Proctor is the Villain , which earned her a Tony award nomination. 
 At the opening night of his play, Joe shared that he met up with Sadie in London before she started Romeo & Juliet on the West End, and gave him some advice. 
 “I saw her before Romeo & Juliet opened when I was across the pond, and she had some good words of advice and really kind of urged me to do [theater too]. She thought I would have a nice time,” Joe shared. ”And then I’ve been texting Gaten [Matarazzo ] as Rent has opened, and yeah, he’s killing it over there.”
 If you missed it, find out what the Stranger Things cast is up to after the series ended last December.
